official: Intensified neoadjuvant-aDjuvant management of REsectable esophageal adenocarcInomA: the MultIcentre, phase II, singlE-aRm DREAMER study
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the activity in terms of pathologic complete response (pCR) rate of the above described neoadjuvant/adjuvant approach.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients competent and able to comprehend, sign and date written informed consent and to comply with scheduled therapeutic and follow up visits, laboratory tests and all other relevant trial procedures.
2. Adequate hepatic function defined by: total bilirubin level ≤ 1.5 × the upper limit of normal (ULN) range, AST and ALT levels ≤ 2.5 × ULN.
3. Adequate renal function defined by an estimated creatinine clearance > 30 mL/min according to the Cockcroft-Gault formula (or local institutional standard method).
4. Absence of mutational status with complete deficiency of the dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase enzyme (DPYD); the presence of mutations associated with partial DPYD deficiency does not exclude eligibility (dose reduction of Fluoropyrimidine expected).
5. For women of childbearing potential and males with partners of childbearing potential: effective contraception for both male and female subjects throughout the study and for at least 2 months after last study treatment administration if the risk of conception exists (Note: effective contraception, defined as 2 barrier methods, or 1 barrier method with a spermicide, an intrauterine device, or use of oral female contraceptive).
6. ≥ 18-year-old, male and female patients.
7. Histologically proven diagnosis of esophageal/GEJ adenocarcinoma.
8. Locally advanced, resectable using the Ivor Lewis procedure, esophageal/GEJ (Siewert I-II) tumor at diagnosis.
9. Radiologically/endoscopically defined cN1-2 or cT2-3 cN0-2 stage, with no evidence of distant spreading, M0, according to TNM classification 8th edition.
10. Treatment naive.
11. Multidisciplinary confirmation of resectability.
12. ECOG PS of 0 to 1.
13. Adequate hematologic function defined by: white blood cell (WBC) count ≥ 2.5 × 109/L, absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥ 1.5 × 109/L, lymphocyte count ≥ 0.5 × 109/L, platelet count ≥ 100 × 109/L, haemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL (may have been transfused).
Exclusion criteria:
1. Evidence of distant metastasis at CT scan or 18FDG-PET.
2. Subjects receiving immunosuppressive agents (such as steroids) for any reason, should be tapered off these drugs before initiation of the trial treatment, with the exception of: subjects with adrenal insufficiency, who may continue corticosteroids at physiologic replacement dose, equivalent to ≤ 10 mg prednisone daily. Intranasal, inhaled, topical steroids. Local steroid injection (e.g., intra-articular injection). Systemic corticosteroids at physiologic doses ≤ 10 mg/day of prednisone or equivalent. Steroids as premedication for hypersensitivity reactions (e.g., CT scan premedication).
3. Active autoimmune disease that might deteriorate when receiving an immunostimulatory agent.
4. Clinically significant cardiovascular disease: cerebral vascular accident/stroke (<6 months prior to enrolment), myocardial infarction (<6 months prior to enrolment), unstable angina, congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association Classification Class ≥ II), or serious uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmia requiring medication.
5. Known severe hypersensitivity to investigational products or any component in its formulations.
6. Known alcohol or drug abuse.
7. Any psychological, familial, sociological or geographical condition potentially hampering compliance with the study protocol and follow-up schedule.
8. Prior mediastinal/abdominal radiotherapy whose fields should be included in the CRT plan.
9. Any oncological prior treatment for the esophageal tumor.
10. Other prior or coexisting malignancy within the last 5 years except adequately treated basal cell or squamous cell skin cancer, carcinoma in situ of the cervix, definitively treated nonmetastatic prostate cancer or patients with another primary malignancy who are definitively relapse-free with at least 3 years relapsed since the diagnosis of the other primary malignancy.
11. Presence of genotypes with complete deficiency of the DPD enzyme.
12. Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
13. Grade >1 (NCI- CTCAE v 6.0.) neuropathy related to concomitant pathologies.
14. Participation in a clinical study or experimental drug treatment within 30 days before enrolment (observational studies and interventional studies without active treatment are allowed).
15. Significant acute or chronic infections including, among others: known history of positive test for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) or known acquired immunodeficiency syndrome. Positivity at hepatitis B virus (HBV) or hepatitis C virus (HCV) screenings is not an exclusion criteria as long as prophylaxis is prescribed whenever judged indicated.
